resources.string_add: MCP server: let AI assistants connect to the site

Turns on /api/mcp: members connect assistants such as Claude or ChatGPT in account settings > Connectors, and their tools act with the member's permissions. Operators also get the tools switched on for them on the Tools tab.
The MCP server is off on this site, so AI assistants can't connect yet.
The MCP server is off on this site: turn it on in Studio > Agents > Settings.
